shared_elements: human figure with head and torso
stylized rendering of hair/headdress as patterned mass
circular/disc motifs (ram horn spirals vs. discs on chest)
justification: Both depict human-like figures with heavily patterned head coverings/hair rendered as repeated incised units, and both use disc/spiral-like circular motifs, but these are generic conventions. A shows a multi-figure narrative scene in low relief with attendants leading horned animals in profile, while B is a single frontal block-like figure bearing isolated emblematic ornaments on its body, with no animals, no procession and no profile view.
